name: 23.13 No access to instructions for use due to no data-communication signal available (e.g. WiFi, ceullular data connection)
potentialCause: No access to instructions for use due to no data-communication signal available (e.g. WiFi, ceullular data connection)
remarks: No data access, no download possible of application. IFU available in app and website. In case logged-in, users can measure and measurement is uploaded as soon as connecion is restored.
alap: Currently no other method is known to further reduce this risk as the IFU are available in app and online
